dating: All Street View is 2014/2015 and predates the 2021 expansion, which was built on the lawn east of PAC: the 2014 east-side entrance views (sv_W14, W15, W16, W17, W18, c8-c13) no longer show the current state. The west, south and north walls are unchanged in Earth 2024 except that the east mansard has been re-clad in light metal.
form: 1970 PAC: a near-square (about 45 m) gymnasium with a flat white membrane roof at ~14.5-15.5 m, ringed by a ~2.5 m light silver metal fascia band, under which four dark slate standing-seam mansard slopes fall to plain red-brown brick walls at ~8-9.5 m. A board-formed concrete stair/vent tower (~4 m square, to ~18 m, NE one ~19.4 m) stands at each corner of the white roof, each wrapped at its foot by a steep dark-metal hipped 'skirt' roof over a one-storey (~4.2 m) brick corner pavilion holding a glazed entrance: Blue North (NW, on W2), Blue South (SW, on W9, name a guess), Red South (SE, on W11), Red North (NE, on W17, now inside the expansion). A plain flat-roofed brick block (pool/annex, ~6 m) extends north (W0, W19, W20); a low east wing (W14) with four roof boxes links to SLC; a 6 m brick lean-to sits on the west wall (W6).

brick.where: every wall: one medium red-brown brick, stretcher bond with light mortar. SV raw is under-exposed (#4f3a34-#49392f, x1.6 gives #7e5d53, Lab 3.6 from brick_slc); sunlit sv_W19 reads #be9e89 (over-exposed). Same brick as the 1968 SLC, so brick_slc keeps the two buildings matched

coping.where: thin dark brown metal coping on every brick parapet (sv_W4, sv_W0)

foundation.where: exposed light grey poured-concrete foundation, stained, under the brick of W0 and W19 (taller where the ground falls to the north) and a narrow strip on W20

mansard.where: standing-seam sloped roofs on the N, S and W sides of the gym and all four corner hip 'skirts' (Earth 2024 reads blue-grey; SV 2014 dark grey). Lab 2.7 from brick_slate

mansard_east.where: east mansard slope only: re-clad in light galvanised/silver standing seam (earth_facade_0, corner_6, W14_m 2024)

fascia_band.where: ~2.5 m vertical metal band between the top of the mansards and the white roof edge, all four sides (sv_W3 sample, Lab 3.0); a darker ribbed/louvred strip runs along its lower half in sv_W3/W10 (window_dark)

main_roof.where: white gym roof with a row of dark drain dots round its edge

low_roofs.where: north block and the corner pavilions: dark grey-brown membrane (ortho)

towers.where: board-formed concrete corner towers (SV reads warm khaki-grey; concrete_raw chosen for material, dc_corrugated is the Lab-nearest)

entrance_fascia.where: brown vertically ribbed metal fascia/canopy boxes over the four corner entrances (sv_W4, sv_W10; Lab 2.5)

sign_band.where: black band under each entrance fascia carrying the entrance name in cream/white letters

door_frames.where: white/silver aluminium entrance doors and frames

door_red.where: red horizontal rail panels across the Red South / Red North doors at ~1.0-1.3 m

door_blue.where: bright blue rail panels across the Blue North (and presumably Blue South) doors (sv_W4). Nearest ion_accent at 13.5

louvres.where: bronze/brown horizontal-blade louvres over the W20 doors; dark grey vertical louvre in the W1 recess (prop_lamp)

W15.notes: SLC walls.json W4 runs (745.8,369.1)->(763.4,364.1) on the same line. 2014 SV (sv_W15) shows the old brick wall and east entrance that the expansion now encloses.

W16.summary: shared wall: identical (reversed) to SLC W3; interior since 2021
W16.notes: Ortho 2023 shows the expansion roof (with its four big exhaust stacks) directly against this line. sv_W16 (2014) with the 'PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES COMPLEX' sign and an entrance is obsolete.

W17.summary: shared wall: coincides with SLC W2; held the 'Red North' entrance (red-rail glazed doors under a brown fascia, sv_W17 2014), which now opens into the expansion

geometry_notes: Footprint walls are right, but the massing is not one 15 m prism: the gym core is a ~45 m square with a 15 m white roof, mansards down to 8.3-9.5 m brick walls, four ~18 m concrete towers with hipped skirts, one-storey (~4 m) corner pavilions (W2/W3, W8/W9, W11/W12), a ~6 m north block (W0/W19/W20), a 6 m west lean-to (W6) and a ~6 m east wing (W13/W14). walls.json height_m 15 is only the gym roof.

W15, W16 and W17 coincide exactly (reversed) with SLC walls W4, W3 and W2: they are shared with the 2021 expansion and should not both be drawn as exterior facades. SLC's spec treats its W2/W3 as exterior; one of the two specs has to give way (photos and ortho say the expansion arm is built against PAC here).
Ground falls ~2-3 m from the south plaza to the north path; W0 and W19 show exposed concrete foundation tapering from ~1.3 m (north) to 0.
Earth wall shots earth_W*_whole for this building are taken from above the roof looking outward and show neighbours, not the walls.
